questions.question: With my income and my car payment, what is the most I could pay each month under Acme's DTI limit?
questions.answer: With your monthly income of $7,400 and your monthly debts of $900, the most you could pay each month under Acme's DTI limit is $2,430. This is based on a maximum debt-to-income ratio of 45% [Acme Underwriting Guide — Debt-to-Income §0].

questions.answer: If your rate lock expires and you extend it beyond the grace period, it will cost 0.125 points per seven days [Acme Product Sheet — Rate Lock Policy §1].
